items.title: Joe Mares Jr. Interview, 1960-04-08
items.q: They played all the old numbers like Millen Boyg and Tin Roof Blues and Zero, all those popular numbers.

ctx.x: Anything about the dance you can remember, for instance, how they played? They played great.
Oh, yeah. They played all the old numbers like Millen Boyg and Tin Roof Blues and Zero, all those popular numbers.
Did they play many things like ordinary pop tunes, you know, or waltzes or anything? Oh, yeah.
